phase: 2B design frozen at schema/model-family level; parameters, event sets and split seed await admissible measured variables

conditional_observables.state: only if time-aligned and subject-specific source objects admitted
conditional_observables.not_substitute: published group map or Sanders interview categories

conditional_observables.state: unobserved in original 20mg-bolus cohort unless PK source maps person/time same object

same_split.rule: no subject or session's derived features across train/test; masks decided from source QC before fitting; no leakage through temporal smoothing or population transforms
same_split.outcome_visibility: held-out outcomes are locked before model selection

score.statistical_unit: participant (NOT 112x112 network edges, EEG channels, or temporal windows)
score.failure: Any absent modality, unmeasured variable, or unidentifiable dose coefficient is masked explicitly, never imputed as a new observed outcome
score.model_specificity: M2 prediction supports distinctive theory only if restricted M1 cannot match same held-out observations under comparably justified priors and capacity

known_design_boundaries: Original 2023 uses bolus 20mg DMT vs placebo; nonzero dose-response curve cannot be inferred solely from one active dose
Public AAL MAT and original voxel NIfTI observations are not identical sources
Participant count 20 deposited pairs does not identify n16 static eligible or n13 dynamic
Unmeasured expectancy, participant belief and pharmacokinetic state are not assumed to be observed
Do not use source-defined sample-specific statistics for held-out tuning
No retrospective model family tightening after seeing test results

models.latent_state: none beyond subject/session baseline and prespecified temporal smooth dependence
models.transition: condition/time/subject effects and a fixed limited-lag autoregressive baseline with missingness; no hidden conscious-agent semantics
fixed_independently: lag count and smoothing regularisation frozen before fitting
predictions: proper distribution over held-out measured features/time bins
models.falsification: Held-out systematic residual beyond predeclared error bound that M1/M2 reduce with the same observables
models.nonpromotion: A null rejection is not evidence for conscious-agent ontology

models.latent_state: finite state-space/HMM or constrained dynamical latent state modelling neurobiological temporal history, salience, self/world reconstruction
models.transition: condition- and measured-history-conditioned transition with bounded, prespecified complexity; no concealed target availability
fixed_independently: number of latent states / allowed complexity set before sealed test evaluation
predictions: held-out neural and optional subjective time-course
posterior latent trajectories with calibration and uncertainty
models.falsification: Fails prespecified held-out improvement and calibration thresholds against M0, or can match M2 and removes claimed distinctive prediction
models.nonpromotion: Endogenous dynamics need not explain philosophical ontology; flexible M1 can observationally simulate M2

models.latent_state: finite latent agent-state proposal with fixed-Q nested subset traces and independently grounded observation maps
models.transition: fixed Q across explicitly comparable trace windows under a declared model; dose/condition may change observation/emission maps only unless separate Q(c) model preregistered
fixed_independently: nested observable event sets and their operational measurement map
latent state capacity bound and fixed-Q assumption
which predictions would fail restricted M1
predictions: predeclared first-return/trace consistency on held-out measurable nested event sets
proper predictive distribution on exactly M0/M1 observables
models.falsification: Measured violations of frozen trace law/assumptions within accuracy limits, or no matched held-out predictive advantage against M1
models.nonpromotion: Generic Markov trace identities also hold for ordinary stochastic models; without distinct exclusion of M1 the outcome is nonidentifiability, not agent evidence

independent_consumers.claim_ceiling: unexplained information-channel effect if replicated; not identity of entity

requires: independently justified access to hidden information if claimed
independent_consumers.claim_ceiling: no promotion from M0-M3 success by analogy alone

before_fitting: recover real 16-person static or a separately declared available observational cohort
freeze exact observable roles and preprocessing
freeze split seed/fraction, model complexity, prediction event sets, uncertainty rule and numerical pass threshold
registration_requirements.model_lock: design candidates; NOT preregistered because measurements and exact choices remain unresolved
